prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact overall, but underestimated strong wins in rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes are often helpful, backed by 4 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests (rounds 4 and 6), though 6 tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in reorder changes proved consistently harmful, leading to a rollback in round 3 and a negative result in round 9.
choose_path layout changes and home notification changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests each.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, and all single-test categories due to mixed results or insufficient tests.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Quick Reference Screen: Insert a dedicated quick-reference screen before home intro showing visual callouts for how to hide, summon, and right-click control the desktop pet. (why: Support received multiple emails (3 emails) from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after completing setup.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Personality Trait Adoption Sub-Flow: Introduce a interactive trait selection step during adoption where users choose their pet's core temperament before generating the adoption certificate. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 66.2% with long median times (89s); increasing engagement during pet setup helps commitment.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Account Sync Safety Hint: Add a clear hint on the sign-in screen assuring returning users that signing in syncs existing pet saves across desktop devices. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets when signing back into accounts.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Render Ready System Notification: Enable desktop system completion notification prompts on the render waiting screen so users can minimize the app while waiting. (why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s (38 minutes); notifying users when generation completes prevents drop-off during long renders.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Companion Controls Welcome Guide Copy: Update the home intro headline and body copy to explicitly instruct users on how to access the pet tray icon and hide/show controls. (why: 3 support emails reported user confusion regarding how to hide or interact with the pet once onboarding finished.)
5: [home, wait_info] Render Stage Live Step Progress Bar: Display explicit step counters and estimated remaining time on the desktop render waiting screen. (why: Waiting screen has high drop-off risks during the mean 2336s wait; wait_info additions are proven effective in past rounds.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Pet Selection Quality Assurance Badge: Add an interactive quality badge indicator on the pet selection stage reassuring users that their custom pet rendering is verified and cloud-backed. (why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation errors or unexpected pet visual results.)

Low-cost copy update backed by 3 emails, but past test for finish copy showed -1.9% lift.
Addresses 38-min mean wait time with strong past confidence (4 winning tests, +1.4% avg).
